    Rizz (Kill) Aura Made By @kylosilly On Discord
    This Is Sigma Femboy Script Fr!!!!
    Pls No Skid (Idc If You Do :3)

local replicated_storage = cloneref(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"))
local workspace = cloneref(game:GetService("Workspace"))

local enemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")

getgenv().settings = {
    enabled = true,
    delay = 0.25 -- 0.25 min if you go under you will get kicked
}

if settings.enabled then
    repeat
        local mobs = {}
        for _, v in next, enemies:GetChildren() do
            table.insert(mobs, v) -- I use tables as you can attack all mobs at once in one remote
        end
        replicated_storage:WaitForChild("Systems"):WaitForChild("Combat"):WaitForChild("PlayerAttack"):FireServer(mobs)
        task.wait(settings.delay)
    until not settings.enabled
end
